name: spamfilter-redis
description: Redis persistence backend for the IMAP spam filter stack. Stores rspamd Bayes tokens, fuzzy hashes, and neural weights. AOF + RDB enabled so the corpus survives container restarts. Install on the spamnet network alongside spamfilter-rspamd, spamfilter-unbound, and spamfilter.

paths.name: Data dir
paths.description: Redis AOF/RDB files. Critical to back up - losing this means retraining Bayes from zero.

paths.name: Server config dir
paths.description: Directory holding the bootstrap-rendered redis.conf (persistence, memory cap, requirepass auth). Read-only. Run bootstrap.sh before installing.
